about.heading: Building bridges between growers and makers
about.lead: We believe the secrets to health, energy and long life are found in nature, through diet and nutrition. Building on the wisdom of traditional and modern food cultures from around the world, we are proud to share nutrient-dense, raw, organic and non-GMO products with producers, manufacturers and end users in Japan.
story: Since 2016, Grande Shokai has imported ingredients from Sudan, Tunisia, Russia, Belarus, Spain and beyond. Our aim is to be a one-stop supply solution — sesame, buckwheat, hibiscus, gum arabic, dairy, honey, dried fruit, nuts, seeds and spices from a single, dependable partner.
Today our customers include wholesalers, hotels and resorts, airlines, supermarkets and retailers, bakeries, fast-food chains and food manufacturers across Japan.

wholesale.heading: Ingredients you can build a product on
wholesale.lead: We build bridges between food producers and ingredient suppliers — with extensive industry contacts, a commitment to finding the right ingredient and the ability to anticipate trends. Our business is built on a reliable supply of high-quality, safe ingredients.
wholesale.specs_note: Typical values for reference. Certificates of analysis and samples are available on request.

products.name: Gum Arabic Hashab HPS
products.text: A dried exudation from the stems and branches of Acacia senegal. Pale white to yellowish-orange, odourless and edible, it is valued worldwide as a natural emulsifier, stabiliser and binder.

products.name: Hibiscus Flower HPS
products.text: Dried calyces of Hibiscus sabdariffa from the fields of Sudan — deep red, pleasantly aromatic and bittersweet. Naturally cultivated without chemical fertilisers, herbicides or pesticides, processed without additives, and carefully cleaned.

products.name: Sesame Seeds
products.text: Sesamum indicum, cultivated for its oil-rich edible seeds. Naturally stable sesame oil stores well, and the seeds bring flavour and texture to breads, salads, biscuits and confectionery.

products.name: Baobab Fruit Pulp
products.text: From Adansonia digitata, the "upside-down tree", known in Sudan as tabaldi, whose fruit is called gongolez. The dry pulp has long been eaten as is or made into a popular juice; the seeds are pressed for oil.

products.name: Premium Deglet Nour Dates
products.text: Golden, translucent and naturally sweet, Deglet Nour is prized among dates. Ours come from Tunisia's Djerid and Nefzaoua regions on the edge of the Sahara, are pitted and hand-selected piece by piece, with an impurity rate below 1% against a 3% industry standard. JAS, Halal and Kosher certified.
uses: Stuffed with nuts, cream or cheese

products.name: Date Syrup
products.text: Pressed from the finest Deglet Nour dates harvested for syrup. No added sugar, no preservatives and no water — 100% date juice with the fruit's own sweetness and flavour.
uses: Pancakes, waffles, yogurt and ice cream
A replacement for sugar or honey in baking

products.name: Senna Pods
products.text: Cassia acutifolia, also known as Nubian, Alexandrian or Khartoum senna, from Sudan. The best grades show bright yellowish-green colour with a faint aroma. Supplied to pharmaceutical manufacturers; in Japan, senna leaves and pods are regulated as pharmaceutical ingredients.

products.name: Beeswax
products.text: The natural wax honeybees secrete to build their combs — yellow to brown, with a gentle honey aroma. A versatile raw material for cosmetics, candles, coatings and polishes.

consulting.heading: Your partner across borders
consulting.lead: We offer high-quality advisory and support services that help start-ups and small and mid-sized companies establish successful operations in new markets — delivering practical solutions for profitability and long-term sustainability.
consulting.japan_text: We help overseas companies open up the Japanese market and implement marketing strategies across high-growth and emerging sectors.
global_text: We help Japanese companies expand internationally through our network across many countries and regions — from first market entry to tax and accounting compliance after entry, M&A and business advisory.
Our consultants tailor every engagement to the client's globalisation needs, taking local business practice and culture into account, backed by a qualified team of professional service providers.

privacy.heading: Privacy policy
intro: Grande Shokai Co., Ltd. ("we") recognises the importance of personal information and complies with the Act on the Protection of Personal Information and related laws and guidelines.

sections.title: 1. Purpose of use
body: We use personal information only to the extent necessary for the following purposes:
list: Responding to enquiries and requests for quotes and samples
Carrying out transactions, shipping and invoicing
Providing information about our products and services

sections.title: 2. Provision to third parties
body: We do not provide personal information to third parties without the individual's consent, except where permitted by law.

sections.title: 3. Security
body: We take necessary and appropriate measures to prevent leakage, loss or damage of personal information.

sections.title: 4. Disclosure and correction
body: If you request disclosure, correction or deletion of your personal information, we will respond promptly after confirming your identity.

sections.title: 5. This website
body: This website does not use cookies, analytics or advertising trackers. The contact form opens your own email app and does not send or store data on our server. Web fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which receives your IP address as part of normal web requests.
